summary: Sends a caller buffer through a COM-style temporary object. Reads the COM interface pointer at obj+0x3FB8, queries a temporary object from it, acquires a lock via vtable offset 0xc4, copies 128 bytes from the caller buffer, unlocks through the virtual dispatch wrapper, releases the temporary object via vtable offset 0x7c, and always returns 1.

local_names.tmp: temporary object queried from the COM interface

operations.description: Dereference this to reach the object header, then read the COM interface pointer at obj+0x3FB8.
Query a temporary object from the interface via VTableQueryWithStackBufferResult.
Acquire a lock on the temporary object through vtable offset 0xc4 via COMVTableCallVia0xc4.
Copy 128 bytes from the caller buffer via MemcpyLikeCopyWithWordByteSplitSizeStore.
Unlock/sync after the buffer copy via VirtualDispatchWrapper_a8c0.
Release the temporary object through vtable offset 0x7c via VTableCallViaOffset0x7c, passing the interface pointer.
